none: PAS FindID 970425: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped and cuirassed right. Reverse description: two soldiers with one standard between them; trapezoid vexillum containing Chi-Rho. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 14.5mm, Weight: 1.16gms, die axis: 12
